text: Condensation algorithm defect across L5-L24: duplicates are merged only when equal frequencies are adjacent. The gate-read Coherence_Spectrum replaces guest values in place without sorting, so equal host frequencies can be separated; those nonadjacent coherent components remain separate and their energies are not combined.

The 31-point moving average at L57 is applied after zeros are inserted at all non-representative positions at L29-L30. This spreads energy across zero gaps and changes amplitudes based on sparse index layout rather than smoothing the condensed frequency/value pairs.

Control-flow initialization defect across L16-L34: m0 is assigned only for periods 2.5, 3, 6, or 9. If period is extended to any other value, the first such iteration uses m0 before assignment or a later iteration silently reuses the previous period's m0. There is no default/error branch.

Line 28 derives an N-by-1 mask from sta(:,2) but applies it with one-subscript linear indexing; for a multi-column matrix it modifies first-column elements rather than sta(mask,2), while line 31 still plots unchanged column 2.

Singularity/termination defect for omega=0 across L3 and L8-L13: the initial expression is 0/sqrt(tanh(0)) and yields NaN; after one Newton pass the NaN relative error makes the comparison error>1e-6 false, so the loop exits and returns NaN rather than detecting the singular input or converging to k=0.
